title: Provider portal home — training and practice appointment state
description: The dashboard shows training and the pending Practice Appointment as the current sequential action cards, with the stage label updated to reflect the provider's position in the Provider Onboarding Pipeline after completing availability.
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  .dashboard-root {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
    background: #0f0e1a;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .dash-topnav {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 32px;
    height: 60px;
    background: rgba(15,14,26,0.95);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }

  .dash-topnav__left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }
  .dash-topnav__wordmark { opacity: 0.85; }
  .dash-topnav__divider { width: 1px; height: 20px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
  .dash-topnav__context { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); font-weight: 500; }
  .dash-topnav__right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .dash-topnav__name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }
  .dash-topnav__avatar {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #a78bfa;
  }

  .dash-sidebar {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #141222 0%, #110f1f 100%);
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 28px 0; gap: 4px;
  }

  .dash-sidebar__section { padding: 0 16px 16px; }

  .dash-nav-item {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s;
    border: none; background: none; width: 100%; text-align: left; font-family: inherit;
  }
  .dash-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); }
  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12); color: #c4b5fd; font-weight: 600; }
  .dash-nav-item__icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0.7; }
  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] .dash-nav-item__icon { opacity: 1; }
  .dash-nav-item__badge {
    margin-left: auto; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2); color: #a78bfa;
  }
  .dash-nav-item__badge[data-color="green"] {
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.15); color: #86efac;
  }

  .sidebar-stage {
    margin: 0 16px 24px; padding: 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
  }
  .sidebar-stage__label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
  .sidebar-stage__name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); }
  .sidebar-stage__track { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .sidebar-stage__step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; }
  .sidebar-stage__dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="done"] { background: #4ade80; }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="active"] { background: #a78bfa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(167,139,250,0.2); }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="pending"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="done"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); text-decoration: line-through; }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="active"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); font-weight: 600; }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="pending"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

  .dash-main {
    overflow-y: auto; padding: 40px 48px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 28px; background: #0f0e1a;
  }

  .dash-page-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .dash-page-header__eyebrow { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
  .dash-page-header__title { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #fff; }
  .dash-page-header__sub { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; }

  /* Profile approved banner */
  .approved-banner {
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.07);
    border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.2);
    border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px 22px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
  }
  .approved-banner__icon {
    width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.12);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .approved-banner__text { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
  .approved-banner__label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(74,222,128,0.7); }
  .approved-banner__title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }
  .approved-banner__desc { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); line-height: 1.5; }
  .approved-banner__chip {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 5px 14px;
    border-radius: 100px; background: rgba(74,222,128,0.15); color: #86efac;
    white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* Two-column layout */
  .dash-columns { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px; gap: 24px; align-items: start; }

  /* Sequential action cards stack */
  .action-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }

  /* Active action card */
  .action-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.1) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.04) 100%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.25);
    border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  }

  .action-card__header {
    padding: 24px 28px 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
  }
  .action-card__overline { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .action-card__badge {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px;
    border-radius: 100px; background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2); color: #c4b5fd; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }
  .action-card__step-num { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
  .action-card__title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #fff; }
  .action-card__desc { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); line-height: 1.6; }
  .action-card__body { padding: 22px 28px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
  .action-card__checklist { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
  .action-checklist-item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }
  .action-checklist-item__dot {
    width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.5); flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 7px;
  }
  .action-checklist-item__text { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); line-height: 1.5; }
  .action-checklist-item__text strong { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-weight: 600; }
  .action-card__footer {
    padding: 20px 28px 28px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  }
  .action-card__cta {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
    width: 100%; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 12px; background: #7c3aed;
    border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff;
    font-family: inherit; transition: background 0.15s;
  }
  .action-card__cta:hover { background: #6d28d9; }
  .action-card__note { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; }

  /* Locked next card */
  .next-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
  .next-card__header {
    padding: 20px 24px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
  }
  .next-card__number {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .next-card__text { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
  .next-card__label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
  .next-card__meta { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); line-height: 1.4; }
  .next-card__lock {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 100px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }

  /* Training resource card */
  .training-resource {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
  .training-resource__icon {
    width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .training-resource__text { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
  .training-resource__label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
  .training-resource__sub { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
  .training-resource__action {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.25);
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #c4b5fd;
    cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; border: none; transition: background 0.15s;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.15);
  }
  .training-resource__action:hover { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.22); }

  /* Mark complete callout */
  .mark-complete-callout {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.18);
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
  .mark-complete-callout__icon {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px;
  }
  .mark-complete-callout__text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
  .mark-complete-callout__title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); }
  .mark-complete-callout__body { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); line-height: 1.5; }

  /* Steps progress card */
  .steps-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .steps-card__header {
    padding: 18px 20px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .steps-card__title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
  .steps-card__count { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
  .steps-card__list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

  .step-item {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; padding: 16px 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  }
  .step-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .step-item[data-state="active"] { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.06); }

  .step-item__indicator { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; padding-top: 2px; }
  .step-item__circle {
    width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .step-item__circle[data-state="done"] { background: rgba(74,222,128,0.15); color: #4ade80; border: 1.5px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.3); }
  .step-item__circle[data-state="active"] { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2); color: #c4b5fd; border: 1.5px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.4); }
  .step-item__circle[data-state="pending"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

  .step-item__content { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
  .step-item__label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
  .step-item__label[data-state="done"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
  .step-item__label[data-state="active"] { color: #fff; }
  .step-item__label[data-state="pending"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
  .step-item__meta { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; }
  .step-item__meta[data-state="done"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
  .step-item__meta[data-state="active"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }
  .step-item__meta[data-state="pending"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }

  .step-item__tag {
    margin-left: auto; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
    padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 100px; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .step-item__tag[data-color="purple"] { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.15); color: #a78bfa; }
  .step-item__tag[data-color="green"] { background: rgba(74,222,128,0.12); color: #86efac; }

  /* What happens after training card */
  .next-steps-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 4px;
  }
  .next-steps-card__header {
    padding: 14px 16px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
  .next-steps-card__title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }
  .next-steps-card__body { padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

  .next-steps-item {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px;
    font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.38); line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .next-steps-item__num {
    width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px;
  }
  .next-steps-item strong { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }

  /* Member list locked */
  .member-list-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
  .section-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
  .section-header__left { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
  .section-header__title {
    font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
  .section-header__sub { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
  .section-header__lock-chip {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }

  .member-list-locked {
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden; opacity: 0.3; pointer-events: none; position: relative;
  }
  .member-list-locked::after {
    content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 40%, rgba(15,14,26,0.9) 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .member-list-header-row {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 120px 100px 100px; gap: 12px;
    padding: 10px 20px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  }
  .member-list-header-row span { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
  .member-list-row {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 120px 100px 100px; gap: 12px;
    padding: 14px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); align-items: center;
  }
  .member-list-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .member-list-row__person { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .member-list-row__avatar-stub { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); flex-shrink: 0; }
  .member-list-row__name-stub { height: 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
  .member-list-row__pill-stub { height: 24px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }

  .member-list-go-live-note {
    text-align: center; padding: 20px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 16px;
  }
  .member-list-go-live-note__icon {
    width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .member-list-go-live-note__title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
  .member-list-go-live-note__desc { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); max-width: 360px; line-height: 1.5; }

  @keyframes pulse-dot {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0.35; }
  }
</style>
